question: MacConkey agar is selective and differential for:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: MacConkey agar contains crystal violet and bile salts -> inhibits the growth of Gram-positive bacteria -> selects for Gram-negative bacteria -> 95% confidence. CHAIN: MacConkey agar contains lactose and pH indicator -> differentiates lactose fermenting (pink colonies) from non-lactose fermenting bacteria (colorless colonies) -> useful for identifying enteric bacteria -> 95%
